model_params.features: wave-12 feature set: the 10 time-domain statistics of the earlier waves (untouched) + 9 order-domain features (platform_lib.features.order): envelope-spectrum energy shares in +-2% bands at the bearing's BPFO, BPFI, BSF (ball-defect order = 2*ball-spin) and FTF characteristic orders and their 2nd harmonics, plus order-domain spectral entropy. Orders are computed per dataset from the actual bearing geometry (CWRU: SKF 6205-2RS JEM, 9 balls, Bd 0.3126 in, Pd 1.537 in -> BPFO 3.5848 / BPFI 5.4152 / BSF 4.7134 / FTF 0.3983; Paderborn: 6203, 8 balls, Bd 6.75 mm, Pd 28.55 mm -> BPFO 3.0543 / BPFI 4.9457 / BSF 3.9932 / FTF 0.3818) and each window is read at ITS recording's shaft speed, so the features are shaft-speed-relative by construction. Residual confounds, stated not hidden: true order resolution is 1/(revolutions per window) — 0.196 orders on CWRU windows (5.11 rev) but 1.25/2.08 orders on Paderborn windows (0.80 rev at N15, 0.48 rev at N09), coarser than the spacing between characteristic orders; slip moves true defect rates ~1-2% off the kinematic orders (hence the +-2% bands); rig transfer functions and sensor placement still differ.

split.protocol: RECORDING-WISE leave-one-recording-out (LeaveOneGroupOut over the SAME 12 recordings as waves 4/9; groups = recording id): in every fold the held-out recording's windows are the test set and NO window from that recording appears in training. Metrics are computed on the pooled out-of-fold predictions. Protocol, recordings, model config and seed are identical to waves 4/9 — the ONLY change is the feature set.

notes: Wave-12 counterpart of the wave-4/9 recording-wise records: identical protocol, recordings, model and seed; the only change is the feature set (10 time-domain -> 19 combined time + order-domain). The three-way comparison lives in extra.comparison_previous_feature_sets. Recording-wise evaluation still does NOT cover unseen fault diameters combined with unseen loads jointly, nor different machines. Data note (as wave 4): 99.mat as served bundles X098 alongside X099; the self-identified X099_DE_time series (2 hp normal) is the one used, read at the catalogue's 1750 rpm for its load (the file ships no RPM scalar).

order_physics_cwru.geometry_source: CWRU Bearing Data Center bearing information (drive-end test bearing SKF 6205-2RS JEM): 9 balls, ball diameter 0.3126 in, pitch diameter 1.537 in, contact angle 0 deg
order_physics_cwru.bsf_convention: the `bsf` feature sits at 2*BSF (ball-defect repetition rate: a ball defect strikes both raceways once per ball revolution); `bsf_spin` is the pure ball spin frequency
order_physics_cwru.speeds: per-recording: in-file X<id>RPM scalar where the file ships one (10 of 12 recordings, all 1796-1797 rpm); CWRU catalogue nominal by load otherwise (98.mat 1 hp -> 1772, 99.mat 2 hp -> 1750)
